footer.description: Developing students since 1997. Supporting the next generation of engineers, leaders, and innovators at Transilvania University.

wheelHints.home: Our story, mission, and core values.

_SECTION_2: ---------------- 2. HOME PAGE (HERO, WHAT IS BEST, WHAT WE DO, VALUES) ----------------

hero.tag: Board of European Students of Technology
hero.subtitle: Developing students since 1997.
hero.description: BEST Brașov is a non-governmental student organization founded in 1997 at Transilvania University. We connect students, the university, and companies while creating real opportunities for personal and professional growth.

local.heading: Our local story in Brașov.
local.p1: Founded in 1997 as the local BEST group at Transilvania University, BEST Brașov connects students with both the academic world and top companies. Our main focus is the personal and professional growth of every member.
local.p2: We organize workshops, academic courses, and company presentations built around what students actually need to learn outside the classroom.
local.p3: Beyond the technical side, we build a close-knit community through social nights, trips, and teambuildings.

international.heading: Part of a European network since 1989.
international.p1: At an international level, BEST (Board of European Students of Technology) was founded in 1989 and is active in 85 universities across 30 countries, bringing together tech students from all over Europe.
international.p2: Through this network, we give students access to academic exchanges, seasonal courses abroad, and direct networking with industry professionals.
international.p3: We encourage practical learning through technical competitions, trainings, and workshops in engineering, IT, robotics, and design.

whatWeDo.title: What do we do?
whatWeDo.subtitle: Supporting students through three main pillars.

pillars.title: Complementary Education
pillars.description: We give students the chance to keep learning in an international setting. Our seasonal courses help participants deepen their technical knowledge while working in multicultural teams.

pillars.title: Career Support
pillars.description: We help students take their first real steps toward a career. Through events like BEST Company Day, we bring them face to face with top employers to discover internships and job openings.

pillars.title: Educational Involvement
pillars.description: We get actively involved in student education through technical competitions, hackathons, and hands-on workshops, encouraging students to put their skills to the test and work as a team.

visionMission.subtitle: Two core principles guide everything we do: building an open, diverse community and helping students reach their full potential.

vision.label: Our Vision
vision.title: Empowered Diversity
vision.desc: People understand and respect different cultures and societies. The environment of empowered diversity supports people in applying their full potential and acting responsibly.

mission.label: Our Mission
mission.title: Developing Students
mission.desc: BEST helps students to achieve an international mindset, to reach a better understanding of cultures and societies and to develop the capacity to work in culturally diverse environments. BEST creates opportunities for personal development of students and supports them in reaching their full potential.

items.title: FUN
items.desc: We love what we do, and we want everyone who joins our activities and events to feel the exact same way.

items.title: FRIENDSHIP
items.desc: We build lasting friendships and stand by each other through both the good moments and the tough ones.

items.title: FLEXIBILITY
items.desc: We stay open to new ideas. No matter what comes up, we adapt and find a way forward.

items.title: OPEN MINDEDNESS
items.desc: We aim to grow every single day. When we become better versions of ourselves, everyone around us grows too.

items.title: IMPROVEMENT
items.desc: We learn from every project, every event, and even a simple coffee chat with another BEST member.

departmentsPage.subtitle: Explore our four departments and see which one fits you best. Tap any card to see what happens behind the scenes!

items.name: Human Resources
items.motto: Are you communicative, sociable, empathetic, and organized? Do you enjoy working with people and supporting them? Then Human Resources might be your place.
items.desc: This department takes care of our members: from outings, parties, and teambuildings to internal trainings and personal development activities. They also evaluate how our projects go so we can keep getting better.

items.name: Fundraising
items.motto: Do you like meeting new people, negotiating, and finding resources to bring projects to life? If you are communicative, organized, and results-driven, Fundraising is a great fit.
items.desc: Fundraising makes sure we have the financial and material support needed to run our events. Members reach out to companies, build partnerships, and negotiate sponsorships, prizes, and student discounts.

items.name: Marketing
items.motto: Are you creative, communicative, and always full of ideas? Do you enjoy making visual content and grabbing people's attention? Then the Marketing department is waiting for you.
items.desc: Marketing shapes the public image of BEST Brașov: poster design, promotional materials, articles, social media, and podcasts, while keeping strong communication with the University, partners, and students.

items.name: Information Technology
items.motto: Are you passionate about coding, web development, and tech? Do you enjoy building websites and solving technical puzzles? Then you will feel right at home in IT.
items.desc: Here you get hands-on experience building websites and managing the technical setup behind our events. You can also explore robotics and work on practical tech projects together with the team.

faqPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know about joining our local group, traveling across Europe, and growing as a student.

cta.title: Still have questions?

items.question: What is BEST Brașov?
items.answer: BEST (Board of European Students of Technology) is a non-profit, non-political student organization. We help students build practical skills, travel across Europe, and connect with companies.

items.question: Who can join the organization?
items.answer: Any student currently enrolled at Transilvania University of Brașov can apply during our recruitment periods, which usually take place in Autumn and Spring.

items.question: Are the courses and travels really free?
items.answer: Mostly, yes! For BEST courses, accommodation, meals, and the academic program are covered by the host local group. You usually only cover a small participation fee and your travel.

items.question: Do I need to be an IT or Computer Science student?
items.answer: Not at all! Even though we focus on technology, our members come from all faculties. We always need people interested in HR, PR, Design, Marketing, Fundraising, and Logistics.

items.question: How much time does it take to be a member?
items.answer: It's completely up to you. You can spend a few hours a week or jump into organizing large events. We are all full-time students, so flexibility always comes first.

_SECTION_7: ---------------- 7. EVENTS PAGE & EVENTS DATA (Dates & images in eventsData.js) ----------------

header.subtitle: We organize events that bring students, universities, and companies closer together. See what is coming up next!

calendar.title: Event Calendar
calendar.nothingPlanned: No events scheduled for this day. Pick another date or jump straight to our next activity.

publicEvents.title: Public Events
publicEvents.subtitle: Open to all students at Transilvania University.

internalEvents.title: Internal Events
internalEvents.subtitle: Dedicated activities and trainings for active BEST members.

international.title: International Courses
international.subtitle: Study, travel, and experience engineering across Europe alongside students from 30 countries.
international.cardDesc: Every season, students from Transilvania University can apply to academic and cultural courses hosted by other BEST local groups across Europe, while each summer we welcome international students right here in Brașov.
international.abroadDesc: Apply in Autumn, Spring, and Summer to travel abroad. Accommodation, meals, and academic sessions are covered.
international.localSummerDesc: Our local edition organized every summer in Brașov for 20 to 30 international technology students.
international.portalHighlight: Check out active destinations, the application guide, and seasonal deadlines on our courses portal.

bit.title: BIT
bit.desc: BEST Information Technology, now in its eighth edition, builds a strong link between IT companies, the university environment, and Brașov students through company presentations, workshops, competitions, and show & tell sessions.

hackathon.title: Hackathon
hackathon.desc: A Hackathon is a programming competition where participants put their skills to work to solve a real challenge. In the winter of 2019, BEST Brașov hosted its first Hackathon, testing students' IT skills over an intense 24-hour sprint.

btw.title: BTW
btw.desc: BEST Training Week is an educational event for Transilvania University students. It offers free training sessions focused mainly on soft skills, helping future graduates grow personally and prepare for a strong career start.

bcds.title: BCDs
bcds.desc: BEST Career Days is dedicated to Transilvania University students who want to meet employers directly, learn from professionals, and take a real step toward an internship or their first job.

bcd.title: BCD
bcd.desc: BEST Company Day gives students from Transilvania University of Brașov the chance to talk directly with specialists from the technical field, learn how companies work, and apply for internships or jobs.

courses.title: BEST Courses
courses.desc: Throughout the year, BEST organizes international courses where tech students travel, make friends from all over Europe, practice their English, and have fun. Each course gathers 20 to 30 students looking for a unique experience beyond regular college life.

gala.title: Anniversary Gala
gala.desc: The Anniversary Gala is an event that we organize every 5 years, the most recent one was last year when we celebrated 25 years of activity. Within it, we present our activity to all partners, be they technical or academic, and publicly thank them for all the help provided.

mw.title: Motivational Weekend
mw.desc: Motivational Weekend is a 3-day trip designed to welcome and integrate new members into our organization. It takes place twice a year right after recruitments, packed with trainings, team activities, and BEST traditions.

ai.title: Internal Anniversary
ai.desc: Internal Anniversary is where BEST Brașov members celebrate another year of activity and honor our new alumni. It's the best moment for newer members to meet older generations and hear their stories from BEST.

hero.subtitle: Step out of your comfort zone, travel across Europe, learn practical skills you won't find in lectures, and meet some of the best friends you'll ever have.
hero.closedTooltip2: Recruitment will resume in the spring!

items.title: Travel Europe
items.desc: Join courses, engineering competitions, and cultural exchanges in 85 universities across 30 countries, mostly for free!

items.title: Level Up Your Skills
items.desc: From Public Speaking to Project Management and Web Development. Learn by doing in a friendly, supportive team.

items.title: Awesome Community
items.desc: Make lifelong friends, go on unforgettable teambuildings, and surround yourself with people who want more from student life.

items.title: Career Boost
items.desc: Work directly with top companies, help organize large events, and build a CV that stands out to any employer.
